# Deposit account (`deposit-account` v1)

A current or savings account: balance, rate, recent transactions and balance history.

**Group:** Retail banking · **Mnemonic:** `ACCT` · **Identifiers:** `ACCT-…` in `accountId`

Open one with `ACCT <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: deposit-account
version: 1
description: "A current or savings account: balance, rate, recent transactions and balance history."
match: { kind: deposit-account, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Retail banking · Deposit account, id: $.accountId }
strip:
  - { label: Type, bind: $.type }
  - { label: Holder, bind: $.holderName }
  - { label: Balance, bind: $.balance, fmt: amount2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Currency, bind: $.currency }
  - { label: Rate, bind: $.rate, fmt: pct2 }
  - { label: Status, bind: $.status, tone: status }
panels:
  - id: transactions
    kind: ladder
    title: Recent transactions
    key: F2
    rows: $.transactions
    columns:
      - { label: Date, bind: "@.date", fmt: date }
      - { label: Description, bind: "@.description" }
      - { label: Amount, bind: "@.amount", fmt: signed2, tone: sign }
      - { label: Balance, bind: "@.balance", fmt: amount2 }
  - id: history
    kind: line
    title: Month-end balance
    area: right
    rows: $.history
    x: month
    y: balance
    fmt: compact
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.customer, 'customer')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
